swi2c_pca9685_init.message0: Init PCA9685 (soft I2C) SDA pin %1 SCL pin %2 I2C address (64=0x40) %3 servo freq Hz %4
swi2c_pca9685_init.tooltip: Bit-bang I2C on any two GPIOs to init the PCA9685 servo board; no hardware I2C used. Default address 0x40, 50 Hz

swi2c_pca9685_is_connected.tooltip: Check whether a PCA9685 at the given address ACKs on the soft-I2C bus

swi2c_pca9685_set_all_angle.tooltip: All 16 PCA9685 channels move to the given angle simultaneously

swi2c_pca9685_set_angle.tooltip: Turn the servo on the given PCA9685 channel to a 0-180 degree angle

swi2c_pca9685_set_us.tooltip: Drive a servo directly by pulse width in microseconds (500-2500), for non-standard servos
